body: The repair kit is left with a note to keep the school-side window closed until the ground dries. The family meeting time is written in the same hand.
title: Fortify while we wait

cites.quote: help us fortify while we wait it out.

gloss: A family waits indoors while a nearby repair and drying period continue.
rival_reading: A response team could have closed windows during decontamination; the note does not identify the treatment.
